comments.author: EGreg
comments.story: Drug resistant bacteria found on ISS mutating to become functionally distinct
comments.why: Explains Coriolis problems of rotation-based gravity.
comments.text: Why not just use rotation to generate artificial gravity via centrifugal force? I guess the answer could be that the sideways motion will drive you crazy due to coriolis forces? See 6 minutes in [VIDEO] But they can just substitute windows with monitors that compensate for the view. Incidentally, the viewscreens on Star Trek etc. always had the ship right side up, so they probably compensated exactly in this way :)
